name: phone_scan
goal: Phone scanner in the left hand: left claw opens 5 s, the phone is put in, gentle grip; left arm (fixed motion) holds the phone over the parcel until it scans, then comes back; the harness routes the code (zone); WALLX picks the parcel up with the right arm and puts it into that zone (all cameras, 120 calls); release; phone handed back.
setup: Parcel label-up where the demo picked it (right of centre, in front of zone 2's front-left corner); phone scanner page open (3x); arms at rest. Stand by to put the phone in and take it out.
